The default 2D motion tool. Everything else in this list assumes you know it.
The motion designer's 3D package — MoGraph is why.
Free, open source, and now genuinely competitive for motion work.
Procedural and simulation work. Steep, deep, unmatched.

Interactive animation that ships straight into apps and the web.
3D in the browser, built for designers rather than for renders.
Where the frames get designed before anything moves.
Real-time rendering, increasingly used for broadcast and film motion.
Node-based real-time visuals — installations, live, generative.
Node-based compositing when After Effects runs out of room.
Edit, grade and finish. Fusion is inside it for free.
Frame-by-frame and rig-based 2D, still the cel animation workhorse.
Hand-drawn frames on an iPad, then straight into comp.
Browser-based 3D that is genuinely fun to learn on.
Lottie export, preview and hosting for UI animation.
The marketplace. If a plugin matters, it is here.
Deep Glow, Splitter and a generous free shelf.
RubberHose and Overlord — rigging and Illustrator-to-AE, solved.
Motion — the keyframe and easing toolkit most people install first.
Packs, presets and transitions for fast turnarounds.
Materials, HDRIs and training for Cinema 4D.
Duik Ángela, the free character rigging standard.
Subscription music and SFX cleared for client work.

Curated, higher-end licensing for film-leaning work.
Music and sound effects, unlimited on subscription.
Community-uploaded sounds under Creative Commons. Check each licence.
Large free SFX library with attribution.
Samples and loops, useful for building beds from scratch.
Templates, stock, fonts and audio in one subscription.
Templates and presets aimed squarely at motion and edit work.
Free stock footage, no attribution required.
Free video clips, music and After Effects templates.
Free HDRIs, textures and models, CC0.
Scanned surfaces and props at production quality.
3D models to buy, download, or just study.
Free type that is safe to embed in client work.

Palettes, contrast checking and colour-blind simulation.
Free transcoding when the delivery spec fights you.
Quick GIF and video conversions in the browser.
